mechanism: the structure signal is placed on the target column marginal of the balanced assignment; cost, residual recursion, readout, export and the assignment rule are the frozen baseline's

frozen_inputs.graph: the TRAIN co-occurrence graph, rebuilt and verified edge for edge against the frozen AF3 cache of issue #136 (315391 edges, 24556 nodes, MATCHED)
frozen_inputs.tau: tau_i = share of item i's incident edges that lie in at least one triangle; 0 for the 31 items with no TRAIN graph row
frozen_inputs.layers: threshold strata of tau, chosen after the review measured the quantile split as nearly inert: tau = 0 is its own layer, then bands (0, 1/3], (1/3, 2/3], (2/3, 1]. Sizes [6118, 6379, 9582, 3327] of 24556
frozen_inputs.communities: Louvain on the TRAIN graph, resolution 1.0, seed 42 (recorded, not used by the terms)

computations.name: stratify
computations.definition: layer_i = searchsorted(quartile cuts of tau, tau_i); rho_g = share of trainable items in layer g

computations.name: buckets
computations.definition: at the end of every epoch the (layer, code) usage mass of the last level is all-reduced; layer g takes the bucket_size unassigned codes with the largest mass from layer g, ties to the lower code index, layer order deciding a contested code; bucket_size = K / G = 64
computations.output: a partition of the K codes into G equal buckets
computations.gradient: discrete and frozen between epochs; epoch 1 uses the uniform partition

computations.name: target marginal
computations.definition: pi_k = rho_{g(k)} / |B_{g(k)}|, normalised; uniform under BEHAVIOR_OFF
computations.output: pi, a distribution over the K codes
computations.gradient: none: it is the assignment's target, not a learned quantity
computations.measured_limit: with quantile strata rho was within 4.19% of 1/4 and the marginal within 2.59% of uniform, which the review measured as 0.39% of tokens changed at the frozen epsilon. The strata are therefore thresholds, not quantiles: rho max/min = 2.88, pi deviates from uniform by up to 50.9% relative, and the same token-change measurement gives 77.3% on a real 1024x256 cost matrix at epsilon = 0.003 with 50 iterations. The marginal is now decisive, and the collapse risk the issue names is live and is what the collision gate and the per-level usage record exist to catch

computations.name: structured assignment
computations.definition: the baseline's Sinkhorn: exp(-centred(C)/eps), column normalisation to B * pi, row normalisation, for SK_ITERS=50 and eps=SK_EPSILON=0.003; the taken code is argmax of the row-normalised plan
computations.output: a row-normalised plan and one integer token for the last level
computations.gradient: the plan is READ-ONLY in the graph: it is computed under no_grad and enters the forward only at argmax, which is the taken code. The differentiable surface is the proxy's carrier (the next entry), a single softmax of the same centring at T = 2/64
computations.measured: back-propagating through the fifty normalisations at epsilon = 0.003 amplifies the sensitivity by (1/eps)^50 per level and drove the four-rank run to NaN inside the first epoch, while every offline single-process check stayed finite; the read-only plan removes that path

computations.name: assignment proxy
computations.definition: h = one_hot(k) + (p - p.detach()); k = argmax(plan) on the last level and argmin(C) before it; p = (1-S)softmax(-centred(C)/T) + S/K on every level, with T = 2/64 and S = 1e-3; the carrier is derived from cost alone, never from the plan
computations.output: one proxy per level whose forward value is the taken code's one-hot
computations.gradient: through p; T follows from the centring's span of 2 and float32's exponent range, S from float32's resolution near one

computations.name: triangle term
computations.definition: L_tri = 1 - mean over batch triangles of the mean pairwise prefix overlap

computations.name: fork term
computations.definition: L_fork = relu(mean_{within-layer batch edges} (1 - overlap) - mean_{cross-layer batch edges} (1 - overlap))
computations.gradient: differentiable; a low-AF3 open edge is never a negative sample

computations.name: prior term
computations.definition: L_prior = mean_l KL(qbar_l || pi) / log(1 / min pi), qbar_l the column mean of the level's transport plan (the usage histogram from the proxy); the divisor is the exact upper bound of that KL, so the term lies in [0, 1]

computations.name: training objective
computations.definition: L = L_RQ + L_tri + L_fork + L_prior, all three weights one
computations.output: the scalar the optimiser steps on
computations.gradient: the same scalar carries encoder, codebooks, decoder

switches.BEHAVIOR_OFF: pi uniform and the layer does not enter the bucket rule; check: every marginal entry equals 1/K
switches.GEOMETRY_OFF: c = 0 so d_c^2/4 equals the squared Euclidean distance; check to 1e-6

coupling.path: TRAIN graph triangles -> tau_i -> quartile layer -> rho_g -> (bucket partition, per-code share) -> pi -> Sinkhorn column target -> taken codes -> SID -> the three terms and their gradients
coupling.behaviour_side: flattening pi (BEHAVIOR_OFF) changes the assignment on the same batch
coupling.geometry_side: c = 0 changes the cost the assignment is taken over
coupling.measured_caveat: because the layers are quartiles of tau, rho is within 4.19% of 1/4 and pi within 2.59% of uniform; the marginal's structural signal is therefore bounded by that spread, while the bucket composition and the two graph terms carry the rest

corrections.what: the layer's transport plan is row-normalised
corrections.why: the baseline normalises the last level's plan to row sums of one; the column target is therefore B * pi, not pi. The uniform special case reproduces the baseline's own sinkhorn to 1e-9, which is the test that pins it

corrections.what: the balanced plan's derivative is removed from the graph
corrections.why: measured: fifty column/row normalisations at epsilon = 0.003 amplify the backward by (1/eps)^50 per level, and the four-rank run left float range inside epoch 1. The plan is now a read-only surface that enters only at argmax; the carrier, not the plan, is what the three terms differentiate. Both the value (the taken code) and the derivative (the carrier) are unchanged in kind from the straight-through pattern the repository already accepts

excluded.surface: argmax of the plan and argmin of the cost
excluded.reason: discrete, and the rule is the baseline's

excluded.surface: the straight-through residual and the derived T, S
excluded.reason: surrogate derivative; the constants are derived, not swept

excluded.surface: tau, the quartile cuts, rho, the bucket partition
excluded.reason: computed once from TRAIN and frozen; the partition changes only between epochs from measured usage

excluded.surface: the max/min re-centring of the cost matrix

decision_log.when: before the single run, after the review of commit 304385ce
decision_log.what: strata are the third-thresholds of tau with the exact zero as its own layer, not its quartiles
decision_log.why: quantiles force an equal population per layer, so the target marginal is almost uniform and the mechanism is inert (review measurement: 0.39% of tokens, and our own: rho spread 4.19%, pi deviation 2.59%). Thresholds leave rho to the data (2.88x between the largest and the smallest layer), which restores the mechanism's intended effect without touching the frozen epsilon, the iteration count or any weight
alternatives_rejected: keeping quantiles and re-defining the bucket target as a continuous tau statistic: it would replace the population share with a second derived quantity and obscure what the assignment is being told
narrowing the claim to a mild prior: it would move the round's novelty onto the two graph terms, which is the #149 shape the review wanted to avoid
